query:
SELECT 
  e.nome as escola,
  e.inep,
  e.municipio,
  t.nome as tecnico,
  os.qtdApInstalado as aps,
  COALESCE(os.observacao, '') as observacao,
  DATE_FORMAT(os.dataConclusao, '%d/%m/%Y %H:%i') as data_conclusao,
  CASE WHEN os.observacao IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(os.observacao) != '' THEN 'SIM' ELSE 'NÃO' END as tem_obs
FROM ordens_servico os
JOIN escolas e ON os.escolaId = e.id
LEFT JOIN tecnicos t ON os.tecnicoId = t.id
WHERE os.status = 'concluida'
ORDER BY os.dataConclusao DESC
LIMIT 20 OFFSET 0
